steps.title: Trace both vacuum ports
steps.text: The lower source nipple passes through an estimated restriction into a chamber shared with the upper EGR outlet. Source-to-outlet continuity remains in both illustrated disc poses.

steps.title: Compare open and seated vent paths
steps.text: A lifted disc permits atmospheric communication with the chamber. A seated disc closes that opening while leaving source and outlet connected. Poses demonstrate topology, not measured duty-cycle or pressure response.

steps.title: Use the five illustrative positions
steps.text: This control moves the small internal vent disc, not the exhaust-gas valve. At0.0mm the disc is seated over the atmospheric opening; at0.8mm the vent is open. The source and EGR outlet remain connected in both poses.

steps.title: Follow air and current separately
steps.text: Air crosses the cap filter and hollow core before meeting the disc. The continuous illustrated winding joins the two terminals and surrounds the core. Its dimensions and fifteen turns are educational estimates.

steps.title: Reset to the seated pose
steps.text: Entering this assembly or resetting returns the control to its seated position. The five positions are checked geometry samples; they are not a PCM command, duty cycle, pressure value or force simulation.

troubleshooting.title: Keep the evidence boundary visible
troubleshooting.text: Exact1994 sources support the filtered electromagnetic regulator mechanism. The internal layout and cap capture use explicitly labeled comparisons and estimates; actual regulator identity, calibration, mounting hardware and source-vacuum plumbing remain unresolved.
